preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 and all(int(x) >= 1 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with a line containing three integers N, M, K (2 ≤ N, M ≤ 10^5, 1 ≤ K ≤ M) where N is the number of friends, M is the number of roads, and K is the index of the road where point P is chosen.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 and all(int(x) >= 1 for x in line.split()) for line in [line for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each of the M lines following the first line of a test case contains three integers A, B, C (1 ≤ A, B ≤ N, 1 ≤ C ≤ 10^9) representing a road connecting friends A and B with length C. The graph is connected, undirected, and has no self-loops or multiple roads between the same pair of friends.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= N and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= N for line in [line for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each road, the nodes A and B are valid friend indices (1 ≤ A, B ≤ N).
The number of roads M satisfies N-1 ≤ M ≤ N(N-1)/2, ensuring the graph is connected and acyclic or cyclic as needed.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line.split()) == 2 and all('0' <= c <= '9' or c == '.' for c in stdout_line) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single line with two space-separated floating-point numbers rounded to exactly 5 decimal places. The first number is the distance of point P from friend A (the first node of the K-th road), and the second is the maximum shortest distance from P to any friend.

postconditions.expression: all('0.00000' <= float(stdout_line.split()[0]) <= float(stdout_line.split()[1]) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: The first output value (distance from P to A) is always less than or equal to the second output value (maximum distance from P to any friend).

postconditions.expression: all(any('.' in x for x in stdout_line.split()) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Both output values are printed with exactly 5 decimal digits, even if trailing zeros are present.
The total number of output lines is exactly T + 1 (1 for each test case, plus the initial T line if present).

postconditions.expression: all('{0:.5f}'.format(float(stdout_line.split()[0])) == stdout_line.split()[0] and '{0:.5f}'.format(float(stdout_line.split()[1])) == stdout_line.split()[1] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: The output values are formatted to exactly 5 decimal places, matching the required precision.
